questions.q: What did each of the two men carry to the fair?
o: One a sack of moss covered with wool, the other a sack of cones covered with nuts
questions.e: One carries moss with wool on top, the other pine cones with nuts on top.

questions.q: How much did one blood brother owe the other?
questions.e: The one with the cones remained in debt for two novacs.

questions.q: Where did one brother propose to lower the other in order to “pay”?
o: Into a well in the square
Into a pit behind the priest's house
Into a cave in the mountains
questions.e: A big pit behind the priest's house.

questions.q: What did the brother find in the pit?
o: Nothing, it was empty and deep

questions.q: How did the debtor try to avoid paying when his brother came to his home?
o: He ran away into the forest
questions.e: He lay on his back with crossed arms while his wife said he had died.

questions.q: Who came at night into the church where the “dead man” lay?
questions.e: Outlaws came in to share their plunder.

questions.q: Why did the robbers flee in terror?
o: The “corpse” sat up and shouted, and a voice answered from the corner: “We're all ready”
questions.e: The corpse sat up shouting, and the brother answered from the corner.
